property_summary: For any two distinct actors each holding a positive balance, successive withdraw calls must both succeed (the reentrancy lock is released after each withdrawal); the mutant leaves the lock set after the first withdraw, so the second withdraw reverts.
change_summary: Delete the statement resetting the lock to false after the function body, so after the first withdraw the lock stays set and every later withdraw reverts (leaving balances unchanged where P would have zeroed them).
